Settings.StreamUserHint: Foundry user name used in OBS Studio to automatically activate the stream overlay.
Settings.HideFoundryUI: Hide Foundry UI in Stream Mode
Settings.HideFoundryUIHint: Hides Foundry sidebars, hotbar, navigation, and controls when Stream Mode is active.
Settings.ThemeHint: Choose the visual aesthetic for the Stream HUD (Fantasy, Tactical, or Minimal).
Settings.OverlayModeHint: Select how the 1920x1080 canvas and camera cutouts are arranged.
Settings.CustomOverlayImgHint: Path to a 1920x1080 PNG/WebP image used when Overlay Mode is set to Custom Image.
Settings.CampaignTitleHint: Displayed in the top bar and roleplay footer.
Settings.CampaignSubtitleHint: Secondary text displayed next to or beneath the campaign title.
Settings.SystemPresetHint: Select a built-in system preset, Auto-Detect, or Custom dot-path mapping.
Settings.CustomMappingJsonHint: JSON configuration defining dot-paths for bars, defense, level, and roll rules when Preset is set to Custom.
Settings.VdoRoomHint: Shared room identifier used to generate VDO.Ninja push and view links.
Settings.ShowPrimaryBarHint: Display the primary health/vitality bar on player cards.
Settings.ShowSecondaryBarHint: Display the secondary resource bar (e.g., Sanity, Mana, Focus) when available.
Settings.ShowTertiaryBarHint: Display the tertiary resource bar (e.g., Willpower, Stamina, Luck) when available.
Settings.ShowDefenseHint: Display AC / Armor / Defense value on player cards.
Settings.ShowConditionsHint: Display active status effect icons on player cards.
Settings.ShowRollsHint: Display temporary dice roll popups on player cards.
Settings.ShowChatFeedHint: Display the recent public rolls and chat messages widget.
Settings.ShowCombatBoxHint: Display the current round, active turn, and next combatant widget.
Settings.ShowMusicTrackerHint: Display currently playing Foundry playlist tracks in the top bar.
Settings.ShowQuestBoxHint: Display the current objective or session note on the overlay.
Settings.CustomQuestTextHint: Text displayed inside the Quest / Objective widget.
Settings.AutoPanCombatHint: Automatically pan the stream camera to the active combatant token.
Settings.AutoCenterIntervalHint: Interval in seconds to re-center the camera on party tokens (0 disables).
Settings.CinematicHandoutsHint: Automatically mirror Image Popouts onto the stream overlay.
Settings.AutoLocationBannerHint: Automatically show a lower-third banner when switching scenes.
Settings.ConfigMenuHint: Configure party slots, VDO.Ninja links, system data mapping, themes, and 1920x1080 card positions.
